props.name: className
props.description: CSS class applied to the element, or a function that returns a class based on the component’s state.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the element, or a function that returns a style object based on the component’s state.

props.name: children
type: null | string | number | bigint | false | true | ReactElement | Iterable<React.ReactNode> | React.ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode> | ((value: any) => ReactNode)
props.description:
Accepts a function that returns a `ReactNode` to format the selected value.
Treat the value as read-only: in `multiple` mode it may be a shared frozen array
when nothing is selected.

props.name: render
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component’s HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.
Accepts a ReactElement or a function that returns the element to render.
